title: A monarch butterfly named Lulu, wearing a tag, flew about 600 miles from Idaho to California
summary_full: Lulu, a monarch butterfly, is currently migrating from Idaho to California, equipped with a Bluetooth tag that allows researchers to track her journey. This migration emphasizes the critical decline of western monarch populations linked to environmental issues. To aid conservation, the Ellwood Friends group has launched a fundraising campaign to name these tagged butterflies. In total, ten butterflies have been released to gather data on their migration routes.
